newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Airtel lost 34 bln pesetas in 1996 - press. [CORRECTED 12:16 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Spain's Airtel lost 34 bln pesetas in 1996 - press. [CORRECTED 12:16 GMT]

text.p: Spain's mobile phone operator Airtel lost 34 billion pesetas in 1996, Spanish financial daily Expansion wrote on Tuesday.
The company was not available for immediate comment. The loss, to be confirmed, was four billion pesetas higher than initially estimated by the company, the newspaper said.

Aitel has around 652,000 contracts at the end of December, versus 15,000 at the end of 1995. (Corrects from "...15,000 more than at the end of 1995"). The competitors Telefonica Moviles had 2.34 millions contracts at the end of December 1996.
British Telecommunications has a 8.5 percent in Airtel, and Santander has another 5.5 percent stake.
